name: Ferruginous-Eyot

civilization.name: Kethrim Ascendancy
civilization.notes: Long dead; only ruins and orbital debris remain of a civilization that flourished before the world turned hostile.

description: A killed landscape, vacuum-scoured and silent. The regolith holds bootprints beautifully; there are some near glass plains from an ancient cataclysm that no expedition has ever claimed.
Light is the weather here. It swings from merciful to murderous within an hour, and everyone schedules their lives around it.
The oldest impact basin predates the system's estimated age by a comfortable margin. The survey bureau has quietly stopped publishing the numbers.
Opportunity here wears armor. Claims on iron, salvageable alloys and uranium are staked, defended, and occasionally avenged, and the nearest law is a week's burn away.
